events.title: Southeast Asian Games Award 2026 Finalist
events.summary: Merry Crisis was featured in Level Up KL 2026 as one of the Finalists for the Southeast Asian Games Award. We were really honored to be showcased amongst some of the best games in the region—it's been such a fever dream. Big shout-out to every one of you who played the game, voted for it in the Audience Choice award, and even came down to play it at our booth in KL (or dragged your friends over)

events.title: Southeast Asian Games Festival Official Selection
events.summary: We're super proud to announce that Merry Crisis is part of the Southeast Asian Games Festival's Official Selection alongside 33 other games from the region! The event is now live on Steam.Check out the showcase on Jun 6, 8am PT for a stacked lineup of excellent games, trailers and announcements! Stay tuned for updates on the summer merch sale, where Merry Crisis exclusive merchandise (e.g. stickers, postcards, art prints and more) will be made available.

events.title: Storyteller's Festival
events.summary: Merry Crisis is part of The Storyteller's Festival this week! 🎉 The showcase highlights narrative-focused games and interactive stories—so if that sounds like your cup of tea, do try the free demo for Merry Crisis on Steam while the festival is live! Stay tuned for more content creators streaming the game this month!
